description: Manages system-level administrative tasks, primarily focusing on database migrations and other core system maintenance operations.

endpoints.name: RunMigrations
endpoints.description: Initiates the execution of pending database migrations to update the system's database schema. This operation ensures the database is up-to-date with the latest application version.
example_uses: Execute all pending system database updates.
Can you trigger the database migration process?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when the system's database schema needs to be updated to reflect changes in the application code, typically after a new deployment or version upgrade. This ensures data consistency and compatibility.
